requirements.description: Remove the duplicated _valid check from new_connection_status() and keep it only in async_new_connection_status()

label.evidence: helpers.py:204 (after): new_connection_status() still starts with "if self._valid:" before call_soon_threadsafe. The check is also still in async_new_connection_status() at :211, so it remains duplicated. The diff only changes the async handler (drops the "_status_listener is self" condition) and never touches line 204.
label.notes: Author says the _valid check was removed from new_connection_status() and the tests updated, but the final code still has it. The new tests (test_connection_status_not_scheduled_after_listener_invalidation) assert call_soon_threadsafe is NOT called after invalidation, so they rely on the check staying in the wrapper.
